title.narrative: Strengthening National Efforts to Prevent Trafficking in Persons and Rehabilitate Victims of Trafficking in the Republic of Moldova

description.narrative: In line with the Governments of Moldova's objectives to prevent and combat trafficking in persons (TiP), this project aims to contribute to the enhancement of the Government's efforts in preventing and countering TiP crimes, in providing qualitative assistance, protection and rehabilitation to victims and potential victims of TiP.
